description: Which custom metadata bytes a limit would count, past its documented 8 KiB: multipart inserts with an 8192-byte and an 8193-byte value under a one-byte key, a 1024-byte key whose value keeps the total at 8193, a key of 8193 bytes, and values that sum to 8193 across two keys; a PATCH that merges a one-byte value into an object whose values already sum to 8192; and an XML PUT with an 8193-byte value. The 2026-11-15 live recording shows that Cloud Storage accepts every one of them, so it holds neither keys nor values to 8 KiB.

steps.name: insert-values-at-limit
steps.body_text:
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8

{{"name":"{object}","metadata":{{"k":""}}}}
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: text/plain

hello
--gcsmimicdiff--
